steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Heed my words, everyone!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I have made a tremendous mistake.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I spoke of the nation's survival, of the trial's meaning, of the Lord of Thunder's might. Yet at root, if I had to surmise, I was simply scared to face it.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And once afflicted with fear, a person will shrink away from its source, making any excuse to justify fleeing from it.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It was not out of any far-seeing wisdom that I founded the Hunter's Association, or trained you in the soldier's way, or kept Her Majesty from facing the Lord of Thunder. In truth, I did this all simply because—

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I am not strong enough.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And I have burdened you all with this fear too.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I have asked for your prudence, the good use of your discretion, and the restraint not to sacrifice your lives for the hunt.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But I have failed to convey to you that which matters most.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: *sigh* If no one's told you you're impossibly pessimistic yet arrogant, I'll do it.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Even if Houei does go under, it's not going to be on you alone.

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: Exactly, Shogun. Choosing caution simply out of blind loyalty to you is the very thing you always warn us against.

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: We chose to be part of the Hunter's Association, to guard our homeland as samurai, because we too believe it is the right choice!

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: You have made no mistake. If we fail, it is simply because we fell short, and no more.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Fair words. Why do I stand here regretting, when I could rejoice?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Rejoice in finally learning the truth, in knowing I haven't become the heartless cur I thought I was.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Rejoice that in this moment, I can still do something for Her Majesty.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Your Majesty.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Endlessly, I've persuaded myself I did no wrong, told myself that I chose the best option from a sea of bad ones.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And over time, I convinced myself that it was the only answer...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: When all along I should have been talking to you, working with you.

spans.text: When all along I should have been

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: In that regard, mayhaps I could say the same of myself.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Once we are returned, I shall enjoy a candid talk with thee.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I look forward to that day.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Hunter's Association, listen up!

steps.name: Samurai Attendants
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Assume square formation and march! We open the way for Her Majesty Hofukaru, for the Iju Hunters!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: For our future!

steps.name: Samurai Attendants
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Samurai Attendants
steps.text: Charge! For Houei and Her Majesty Hofukaru!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Haha, I'm here to back you up!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I'll be frank, old friend.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: There's no certainty in life.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I've done a poor job at everything I set out to do. Yet here I am, ready to finally confront my failures, only to realize I might not be such a failure after all.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: You don't get it. This is the sort of thing that happens to us inventors every day!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Success is always a fluke! But as long as the results are good enough, who can complain?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Hah, well said!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Your Majesty! Go forth!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Give me a shout if you need support, Your Majesty! I'll get to test the range on this thing!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: This place... This altar... This, then is where the people of Old Houei...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The closer I draw, the sharper I sense the aura of the curse.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I finally understand the nature of the power that called to me, back in the snowy mountains...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I thought it the Lord of Thunder, but it was the Gyorin. All along, it has been the Gyorin drawing me in...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Mother, the root of our calamities, the truth of the trial... it is the Gyorin, isn't it?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Be ready for me, Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hofukaru, now!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Hear us, Lord of Thunder! We pray only that thou lend us thy power!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Urgh—!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What now, Orchid? I don't think it's working!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Tsk. What a stubborn pest.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: All the damage we've dealt to it, and it still won't falter. It's fighting us harder, even.

spans.text: All the damage we've dealt to it, and it still won't falter. It's fighting us

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Has the curse taken over its mind?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Or did it—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: No, Orchid, something's wrong with it—
Suddenly, a shift.
Struggling free of Hofukaru's power, the Lord of Thunder does not follow with an immediate attack. Instead, it begins to roar in pain.
It writhes and writhes. Black miasma erupts like steam from its body. All present feel their blood run cold.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid, the curse is gonna consume it completely! Are we gonna have to kill it?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...No more holding back, Catapult.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If the curse does devour the Lord of Thunder, we'll have a new worst case.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: ...Got it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Do you understand, Hofukaru?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: There's nothing more to consider. We tried as hard as we possibly could. Whatever happens now, we can only accept it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Take the chance while it's writhing to—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Thunderbugs?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: When did they...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: They're flying in from the bamboo grove!
To everyone's surprise, a blue 'bridge' has formed through the murk of the underground ruins.
A glowing stream of Thunderbugs, flying in from the subterranean grove.
They begin to surround the Lord of Thunder in growing numbers, as if building up to something.
As their numbers increase, the miasma about its body rages harder too.
Yet when bathed in the cerulean insects' light, some part of the Lord of Thunder's defiled appearance gives way to a hint of dangerous beauty.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It summoned them all? But... why?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Lord of Thunder, what are you—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid, I have a hunch.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I don't think it's been completely corrupted by the curse... I think it's been fighting against it all this time. And now, it's about to win?
While everyone hesitates, the Lord of Thunder's pain seems to abate somewhat, and it nimbly leaps away to a high perch.
There it stands, holding its head high, letting out a long cry.
And then—the earth splits.

steps.name: Injured Samurai
steps.text: Ugh—I can still fight!

steps.name: Houei Commoner
steps.text: Don't be brave. There's other samurai taking your place. You focus on resting up!

steps.name: Injured Samurai
steps.text: I-I've slain a good few beasts! I've done the shogun proud!

steps.name: Houei Commoner
steps.text: Relax, everyone's doing well. Now, rest.

steps.name: Houei Commoner
steps.text: (Murmur) Your Majesty, Master Suponosuke, fine Hunters, we will keep our nation safe. Please, return to us unharmed...

steps.name: Injured Samurai
steps.text: Guh...

steps.name: Houei Commoner
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Injured Samurai
steps.text: Am I seeing things? Is that a black cloud over the Gyorin there?
All throughout Houei City, people lift their heads to see the Gyorin—
Whereupon a tremendous thunderbolt bursts through the dark clouds of night, and crashes against the snowy mountain beneath the Gyorin.
If anyone were closer, they would spy a great cave now struck open by the bolt, too deep to see the bottom.
But they would also hear that heaven-shaking roar rising from below—
That wild, untamed roar.
With that roar, the massive thunderbolt splits through the deceptively brittle rock, and falls upon the Lord of Thunder.
An instant of galvanizing light seems to shake the whole cavern below, in all its gloom.
Bathed in its electric glow, the Lord of Thunder completes its final metamorphosis, and once more lets out a roar.
This time, blue lightning wreathes its body.
Its mane stands on end, like a pure white wave frozen in motion. Each and every hair jumps with lightning. From the tips, arcs split and scatter pure embers.
Its scales gleam like turquoise, and golden-white rivers of light flow. It shakes its tail, and the sparks draw amber whips through the air that cut open cracks in the dark.
A ray of moonlight spills through the opening above.
Under the moon's silver shine, it stands the spitting image of the realm's most noble ruler.
It is at this moment that every beast halts in its actions.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Did it... use the lightning to purge itself of the curse?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: No. Look closer.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: It's still emitting the miasma... but its movements, they've totally changed.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: It didn't purge the curse, it conquered it! It's made it part of its own power!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Guess we didn't need to do anything, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...You're telling me. There's really no telling what will happen in these great lands, is there?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We thought the former lord had given us the key to the puzzle. We thought our task was to save the Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We were so sure we had to save it, free it from the pits of the curse...

spans.text: we had to save it, free it from the pits of the curse...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But in the end, it didn't need saving at all.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well, I dunno about that.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Beasts hone themselves through fighting. I figure it probably couldn't have overcome the curse if we hadn't fought it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So in a way, that counts as saving it, right?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Perhaps.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Now, Your Meowjesty! Use Wyvern Riding on it!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Harness its paw-er for yourself!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I shall try—
A bolt of lightning bursts out and strikes the Wirebug from Hofukaru's grasp. The Lord of Thunder snorts with indignity. It does not take kindly to Hofukaru's intent, it seems.
But neither does it follow up. It simply watches her, quietly.
As if awaiting something.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Looks like it doesn't wanna let you use Wyvern Riding on it yet. Not until you've beaten it completely.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Since learning the truth, I have been filled with remorse in the face of thee, Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: For thou wert but a victim of the curse, and without thee to instinctively prey on the other cursed beasts, the curse's spread may have been swifter still.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: But 'twas not we who summoned thee to Houei. Yet my nation and its people have dwelt these many years in thy shadow.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: And it was by thy hand, no other, that my most beloved mother died.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: A wronging that mine heart cannot so lightly forget.

steps.name: Lord of Thunder
steps.text: (Growls)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It can't understand you, Hofukaru.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's just a beast. It's not like being dropped into a strange land by the Gyorin left it at a loss, nor does it resent fate for letting the curse plague it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It just accepts everything that's happened according to its own instincts. That's all.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's in a new land now, so it'll just survive here.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's been harassed by the curse, so it'll overcome it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The Hexhowls tried to kill it, so it'll try to kill them.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's all. It doesn't care whether you hate it or not, whether you love it or not. That doesn't matter to it at all.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: A creature's instinct is simply to survive.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That's right. It won't work with us just because the Gyorin's the threat now.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: After all, we're trying to challenge its dignity as the 'Lord' here.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: In the end, we can only rely on our weapons.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...Thou speakest truth.
The sun climbs in the east. Today is a good day to go hunting.
